name: callout
description: Rich callout/alert block with 6 types, optional title, and optional fold (collapsible). CSS loaded globally via base. Shortcode outputs only HTML; no Scratch resource injection needed.

params.description: Callout visual type. Values: note | info | warning | error | tip | success
params.effect: Sets border color and background color via .mdf-callout-{type} class

params.description: Optional heading text shown above the callout body
Set to 'open' to render as an initially-open collapsible <details> block
params.effect: Wraps callout in <details open> with <summary> for the title

css.note: Override to restyle callout types. Or add higher-specificity rules in main.css.

locked.reason: No locked contracts — CSS classes are the only API and are fully overridable

css_in_main.note: Override individual type styles via higher-specificity rules in main.css

partials.note: Override to change HTML structure. Keep .mdf-callout and .mdf-callout-{type} classes for CSS compatibility.
